# [pytorch compile] Incorrect result when `compile` changes

<!-- DRAFT generated by tcc. Review every section before filing (plan 18.6). -->

## Summary
The compiled execution is inconsistent with Python eager execution when `compile` changes from `{'dynamic': True}` to `(base)`.
all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
This test was generated because the static analysis found: compile flag changes specialization (factor `compile.dynamic`, oracles ['value', 'metadata']).

## Environment
- Python: 3.12.13
- Framework: PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128
- Compiler backend: inductor
- Commit/version: 449b1768410104d3ed79d3bcfe4ba1d65c7f22c0
- CUDA/ROCm: 12.8
- GPU: Tesla T4
- OS: Linux 6.12.90+
- Triton: 3.6.0

## Minimal Reproducer

```python
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)

def model():
    out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(x, x, x)   # [4, 12, 4]
    out, _ = m_mha(out, out, out)                    # [4, 12, 4]
    out = torch.fft.fft(out).abs()                   # [4, 12, 4] real
    out = m_hardswish(out)                           # [4, 12, 4]
    return out

args = (...)  # see execution_trace.json

eager = model(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(model, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```

## Expected Behavior

Eager/reference result:

```text
structure: T
[0] [0.02621588856, 0.02909477986, 0.06496594101, 0.02909477986, 0.1059054136, 0.0448638536, 0.1027102247, 0.0448638536, ... (184 more)]
```

## Actual Behavior

Compiled result:

```text
exception AssertionError: expected size 4==4, stride 4==48 at dim=0; expected size 12==12, stride 16==4 at dim=1
Error in op: torch.ops.aten._fft_r2c.default
This error most often comes from a incorrect fake (aka meta) kernel for a custom op.
Use torch.library.opcheck to test your custom op.
See https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/library.html#torch.library.opcheck
```
